opening.argument: The speaker directly urges members to upgrade their OneCoin packages, promising an extra split for an upgrade to Infinity from Tycoon, Premium, or Festival by June 5, 2016. A promotions slide also offers free package codes conditional on banking specified numbers of package codes. Together, the deadline, promised split, and free-package offer press members toward acquiring more through upgrades and banking codes. The available evidence does not establish whether the offered services were delivered, whether accounts were charged, or whether anyone suffered a loss.

citations.quote: Visit your back end now and upgrade your package to take advantage of this astonishing offer!
If you upgrade to an Infinity package from either Tycoon, Premium or Festival by the 5th of June 2016, you will get one extra split on top of what the upgrade initially gives you.
